summary: HISØY FRIVILLIGSENTRAL STI (org. no. 914 229 421) is a foundation (STI) based in Arendal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2014-11-15. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 88.996 (Andre sosialtjenester uten botilbud ellers). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.1 m and net income was -NOK 63 760. CEO: Lise-Marie Lunde Bygland; board chair: Nina Elisabeth Milde; auditor: SØRLANDET KOMMUNEREVISJON IKS.
